subject.summary: 27-1024.00 designs graphics for specific commercial or promotional needs, possibly using multiple media to create artistic or decorative effects. The 19 tasks include 17 core and 2 supplementary: negotiating layouts, researching illustrations, developing draft concepts, selecting fonts, producing graphics, proofreading final layouts, preparing print files, and so on; importance is not adoption rate or legal authority, and brand compliance and release checking are editorial process advice. 2025 U.S. national 10th/25th/50th/75th/90th percentile annual wages for this occupation 27-1024 are 39,520/49,040/62,960/81,830/104,910 U.S. dollars, hourly 19.00/23.58/30.27/39.34/50.44 U.S. dollars. OEWS includes production bonuses and commissions, and excludes non-production bonuses, overtime premiums, shift differentials, benefits, and self-employment; percentiles are not starting pay, seniority, or an individual's take-home pay. The current projection for 2025—2035 is a decline of 1.7%, including self-employment; see the body text for the specific scope.
